title: Modernizing Office 365 Connector Workflows to Microsoft Graph (Logic Apps / Power Automate)
author_notes: NET-NEW cluster (catalog had 0 Logic Apps mailbox / 0 managed-identity-to-M365 / 0 Graph-mail coverage; the lone 'Sentinel SOAR — Automation Rules & Playbooks (Logic Apps)' is a different domain and must NOT be duplicated). Cross-reference the SIBLINGS in this cluster by title, do not reproduce them: #1 'Exchange Online Mailbox Automation with Logic Apps Managed Identity — Replacing the O365 Connector with Microsoft Graph'; #2 'Event-Driven Mail Processing with Microsoft Graph Change Notifications (Logic Apps + Managed Identity)'; #3 'Graph Mailbox Polling Workflows in Azure Logic Apps (Managed Identity, No Service Account)'; #4 'Scoping Application-Permission Mailbox Access — Graph RBAC & Application Access Policies for Exchange Online'; #5 'Managed Identities for Azure Logic Apps & Functions — Authenticating to Microsoft 365 Without Stored Credentials'; #6 'Modernizing Office 365 Connector Workflows to Microsoft Graph (Logic Apps / Power Automate)'. THIS IS #6, the estate-scale migration PROGRAM. It orchestrates the per-flow patterns from #1/#2/#3/#5 and defers scoping to #4 — reference them as the building blocks, do not reproduce their depth. Program-level effort (inventory, classify, wave rollout) justifies the higher price. Everything version/feature/licensing-specific — whether a given Office 365 Outlook connector trigger supports managed identity, exact Graph permission names/scopes, Graph change-notification max subscription lifetime + renewal cadence + supported mailbox resources, Application Access Policy vs the newer Graph RBAC-for-Exchange model and which to use, Logic Apps Standard vs Consumption differences, national-cloud endpoints — MUST be flagged 'verify against current Microsoft documentation' and never asserted as fact. Least-privilege APPLICATION Graph permission (e.g. Mail.Read) scoped to ONE mailbox is the security spine of every product here. Author for a novice admin, name every object created (Logic App, managed identity, app role assignment, Graph subscription, access policy/RBAC scope, Key Vault if any) and reuse names verbatim. White-label: no Phoenixtekk / client / tenant names; contoso.com only. PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph) for discovery/validation/reporting + one -WhatIf-gated helper; workflow JSON/ARM/Bicep as config artifacts where relevant.
